contract.objective: Stop delivery descendants on SIGQUIT through Athena's installed launcher and wrapper.

Installed-path tests cover cooperative workers and resistant workers requiring SIGKILL escalation for both direct and process-group SIGQUIT.
Existing SIGINT, SIGTERM, and SIGHUP behavior remains covered; Windows skips SIGQUIT listener registration and removal through the ordinary production wrapper path.
